name: AiDiffReview
purpose: An explicit approve or reject boundary around an AI-proposed document change.
description: AI proposals begin with unchanged context folded and the first change in view. Added lines are green with plus markers; removed lines are red with minus markers, with stronger highlights on the exact changed text. The AI accent identifies proposal provenance only. Show all lines, split/unified layouts, and change navigation support a full review before explicit approval or rejection.

props.name: onApprove
props.type: ((content: string, context: AiReviewActionContext) => void | Promise<void>) | undefined

props.name: provenance
props.defaultValue: "Generated from the supplied configuration and review context."

props.name: status
props.description: External review state. A document change always requires a fresh review.

guidance.overview: An explicit approve or reject boundary around an AI-proposed document change.
usage: Supply original, proposed, documentName, and the correct language. Approval applies to those document snapshots, not an unspecified future revision.
Changing original or proposed invalidates the prior decision and aborts a pending review action.
Honor the callback AbortSignal and persist the supplied snapshot only after explicit approval. Failures remain visible for retry.
accessibility: The diff retains keyboard navigation and labeled additions/removals; approve and reject are separate, named buttons.
Pending actions are guarded against duplicate submissions, and a completed decision is exposed as a status with a stable focus target.
intent: AI marks proposal origin; approval is a user decision, and green/red diff markings describe additions and removals rather than desirability.
context: Use before applying generated configuration or source changes to application state.
